 JUDGMENT

The Police Inspector of Cottonpet Police Station, Bengaluru has filed this charge sheet against the accused for the offence punishable u/Sec.63 and 65 of Copyright Act and Sec.420 of IPC.

The brief facts of the prosecution case are as under:
It is the case of the prosecution that on 13.09.2017 at about 2.40 pm the accused person found in possession and selling of duplicate toners and cartridge of HP Company of CW.1 situated at No.58/5, 2 nd floor, Binny Mill road, Cottonpet,
Bengaluru, without obtaining any licence or permission from CW.1 and thereby violated the copyright of the company and also cheated to the public and also CW.1.

In this regard, CW.1 lodged first information statement and based on the same FIR came to be registered in Cr.No.199/2017 for the offences punishable u/Sec.63 and 65 of Copyright Act and Sec.420, 511 r/w Sec.511 of IPC.
Thereafter, CW.1 along with CW.2 to CW.7 rushed to the spot and conducted raid and seized the alleged duplicate toners by drawing panchanama.

Thereafter, PI completed the investigation and filed the charge sheet against the accused person for the offences punishable u/Sec. 63 of Copyright Act and Sec.420 of IPC.
3.
After filing of the charge sheet this Court has taken the cognizance of the offences punishable u/Sec. 63 and 65 of Copyright Act and Sec.420 of IPC and issued summons to the accused person.
He has appeared before this Court through his counsel and obtained bail.
The copy of the charge sheet has been furnished to the accused as per Sec.207 of Cr.P.C.
After hearing both sides the charge has been framed and read over to accused.
But he has pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
Hence, the case has been posted for prosecution evidence.
4. The prosecution in order to prove its case has examined 4 witnesses as PW.1 to PW.4 and 13 documents got marked as Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.13 and MO.1 to MO.7.
Thereafter, the statement of the accused person u/Sec.313 of Cr.P.C. has been recorded.
He has denied the incriminating circumstances appearing in the prosecution evidence against him.
He has not chosen to adduce his defence evidence.
5. I have heard the arguments of both sides.
Perused the entire oral evidence and documents placed on record.

6. The points that arise for my consideration are as under:
(1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond reasonable doubt that on 13.09.2017 at about 2.40 pm the accused person found in possession and selling of duplicate toners and cartridge of HP Company of CW.1 situated at No.58/5, 2nd floor, Binny Mill road, Cottonpet, Bengaluru, without obtaining any licence or permission from CW.1 and thereby violated the copyright of the company and also cheated to the public and also CW.1 and thereby committed an offences punishable under Sec.63 and 65 of Copyright Act and Sec.420 of IPC ?

(2) What order ?

My findings to the above points are as under:
Point No.1 : In the Negative, Point No.2 : As per final order, for the following :
REASONS 8. Point No.1 :-

The prosecution has alleged that on 13.09.2017 at about 2.40 pm the accused person found in possession and selling of duplicate toners and cartridge of HP Company of CW.1 situated at No.58/5, 2 nd floor, Binny Mill road, Cottonpet, Bengaluru, without obtaining any licence or permission from CW.1 and thereby violated the copyright of the company and also cheated to the public and also CW.1.
Therefore, the burden is on the prosecution to prove guilt of the accused.

As already stated supra, the prosecution has examined 4 witnesses as PW.1 to PW.4 and got marked 13 documents as Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.13 and MO.1 to MO.7.
9.
The prosecution has been examined CW.1 as PW.1.

He being power of attorney holder of Hewlett Packard Company he deposed before this Court he was working as a Field Investigation Officer in the said company he conducting survey and arrange for raid if anyone violates the copyright of his company.
His company has been registered at Delhi and his company is having logo mark.
Further he specifically deposed that in 2017 his company is having information that someone had manufacturing and selling his company duplicate products in open market.
On that credible information he came to Bengaluru city and he had made market survey and found in Binny Mill Road one person by name Avadesh Kumar had selling his company products.

Therefore, he lodged written complaint against the said Avadesh Kumar, after that the police officers came to the place and found his company duplicate cartridges, toner, cartridges, ink cartridges, packings box and the said articles were seized by the police officers in his and panch witnesses were present and he identified Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.11 and MO.1 to Mo.7.
The said accused selling of the above articles and carried business without permission of HP Company and he cheated public by showing as HP original items in order to get profit unlawfully.
Due to the act of the accused the HP company sustained a total tune of Rs.1,75,000/-.
Therefore, he prayed for accused in accordance with law.
He has been subjected cross- examination by the accused.
During the course of cross- examination it is elicited that he did not knew to read and write Kannada language.
He did not know the contents of Ex.P.2.
Further it is admitted by PW.1 that he representing company of GCS Management and solution private limited, the said GCS management company is not owner of Trade Mark of HP Company.
Further he clearly admitted that he is not a direct employee of HP Company.
Further he clearly and categorically admitted that he did not produce letter of authorization which is issued by HP Company.
Further this witness volunteers before this Court that his company i.e. GCS Management and Solution Private Limited Company gave authorization to HP Company.

Further it is elicited that on that day they leave police station at around 12.20 pm at the time of seizing articles some public 5-10 were also present, the police officers sealed the articles in their police department seal.
Further he expressed inability to say whether the police officers sealed the articles at spot and which impression of seal used by police officers.
Further it is admitted by PW.1 that HP Company stickers stick on MO.1 to MO.7.

Further it is admitted by PW.1 that Ex.P.10 issued after raid .
Further it is elicited and admitted by PW.1 that he did not mention in his complaint what are all distinguished features of original cartridges of HP Company.

Further this witness undertook before this Court that he can produce original copies of Ex.P.3 to Ex.P.6 and he denied other formal suggestions made by accused counsel during course of cross-examination.
10. The prosecution has been examined CW.7 as PW.2.

He deposed before this Court that on 13/09/2017 at about 12.15 pm himself, PSI, CW.1, 5 to 7 went to Manjushree building, at 2nd floor,
and verified the cartridges.
He further deposed that the accused were selling duplicate cartridges to the public at Rs.2,000/- and cheated the public and also company and PSI arrested the accused and drawn panchanama.
He has been cross-examined by the accused counsel and he denied the other suggestion made by accused counsel.
11. The prosecution has been examined CW.8 as PW.3.

He deposed before this Court that on 13/9/2017 at about 12.15 pm when he was on station duty at that time complainant came to Police Station and filed written complaint against the accused person and on the basis of it he registered a case against the accused person and they went to spot and complainant verified the toners and cartridge and drawn panchanama and seized the same and obtained documents from the complainant and recorded the statements of witnesses.
During the course of cross- examination by accused counsel that it is elicited that they did not produced Cw.3 to 9 original documents before him.
Cw.1 has belongs to GCS company, GCS company and HP Company are both different companies.
The GCS company did not gave any complaint, they infringed their trade mark against this accused.
Further it is admitted that in Ex.P.1 and 2 they did not stated in HP Company which design, colour logo used by the accused.
Further it is admitted that he did not mention in documents the CW.1 took original HP company cartridge.
Further it is admitted by this witness that they stick HP Company label on materials.
Further it is admitted by the Investigation Officer that he did not sealed on seized properties and he did not cited neighbour panch witnesses in his charge sheet.
Further he denied the suggestion of accused that at the time of giving complaint of this case there is no existence of GCS Company.

Further it is elicited that CW.1 stated before him that the accused took old HP company cartridges and he prepared newly by sticking HP company label on the Came To Police Station And Filed Written vs Was Tenant In Her House Since 16 Years And ... on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15378586/

Further he denied the other suggestion made by accused counsel during the course of cross- examination.
12. The prosecution has been examined CW.4 as PW.4.
She deposed before this Court that she knows accused and accused was tenant in her house since 16 years and she did not gave any statement before the police.
Though the learned Sr.APP cross-examined her, nothing worths were elicited to support the prosecution case.
She has been cross-examined by the accused counsel

and she denied the other suggestion made by accused counsel.

But complainant/PW.1 stating that he had selling HP company duplicate products.
In the cross- examination it is elicited that MO.1 to 7 its did not contained any sealed or embossed of GCS and HP company.

It can easily remove and repasted on Mo.1 to 7.

Further It is relevant to note that the Investigation Officer stated that PW.1 brought original HP Company cartridge and he seized original HP Company cartridge and duplicate articles.
Further Investigation Officer admitted before this Court that he did not seized at spot and MO.1 to 6 are did not bear original HP Company seal.

Ex.P.2 is not proved before this Court as per law.
Non-examination of panch witnesses is fatal to the case of the prosecution.

Further the PW.2 i.e. Investigation Officer clearly admitted in the cross-examination that CW.1 took original HP Company cartridge at the time of drawing panchanama and he seized original HP Company cartridge toner.
But the said original HP company cartridge not produced before this Court.
Further PW.1 clearly stated that he did not produced original HP company toner before Investigation Officer.

PW.1 contended that he was power of attoney holder by the HP company and he was working as a Field Investigation Officer in the said company.
In order to substantiate the above fact PW.1 produced letter of appointment dated 6/6/2016 .

On perusal of same, one Barbara Duggan Senior Litigation Counsel,
of legal age and representing HP company with a principal place of business at 11445 USA appoints one Anshuman Saha as a product Security Consultant in GCS Management Solutions India Private Limited.

Consultant has to power to act on behalf of HP in a lawful manner before law enforcement and judicial authority in India.

So as per letter of appointment the PW.1 is having authority to act on behalf of HP in the lawful detection and investigation of persons or business counterfeit HP Trade Mark, and to lawfully file petitions regarding the unlawful use or production of counterfeit HP marks and associated criminal activity before the competent authorities.
The arguments canvassed by the learned accused counsel PW.1 neither power of attorney or employee is not forthcoming from the documents produced by PW.1 is holds no water.

Admittedly, panch witnesses are not examined in order to prove the panchanama PW.1 and Investigation Officer they stated self serving statement before this Court they seized articles from the possession of accused and MO.1 to 7 are counterfeit product of HP company.

But to the contrary, it is clearly elicited from the mouth of PW.1 and 2 that the accused used spare parts of HP company and he prepared another product and he reused HP company cartridge and toners by sticking HP company sticker.
But as per Ex.P.1 accused reused toner cartridge, packed boxes empty toners and original security labels.
PW.1 and 2 themselves admitted before this Court that except stick HP company stickers on MO.1 to 7 there is no using of HP company trade mark or embossing HP company logo on products.
PW.4 being building owner of accused shop she completely turned hostile.
PW.4 evidence did not help to the case of prosecution.
The prosecution completely failed to prove before this Court that accused has using HP company logo and symbol and he prepared duplicate products and he sell the same to the customers.

First of all the prosecution did not examined panch witnesses in order to prove the Mo.1 to 7 are alleged to be seized articles were seized from the possession of accused and MO.1 to 7 are not sealed by the Investigation Officer as prescribed under law.
There could be chance to stick on the HP company products by anybody.
The said sticker easily stick and removed at any time at anybody.
So it creates serious doubt about the version of the prosecution.
Admittedly, the HP company trade mark and logo not used by accused.
It is alleged he used HP company stickers on the products.
But Investigation Officer did not investigate in his investigation where the said stickers produce ? and who produce, it is not forthcoming from the evidence of prosecution.

Therefore, the prosecution has utterly failed to prove the charges levelled against the accused beyond reasonable doubt.
Accordingly, I answer Point No.1 in the negative.
14. Point No.2:

For the aforesaid reasons, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER Acting under Section 248(1) of Cr.P.C., accused is hereby acquitted of the offences punishable u/Sec. 63 and 65 of Copyright Act and Sec.420, of IPC.
The bail bond executed by accused shall continue for a period of two months from the date of this order and thereafter same shall stands cancelled automatically.
Mo.1 to MO.7 shall be destroyed as worthless after the appeal period is over.
